title: Texas Roadhouse, Inc. to Announce Second Quarter Earnings on August 6, 2026
summary: LOUISVILLE, Ky., July 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Texas Roadhouse, Inc. (NasdaqGS: TXRH) announced today that it will release second quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, August 6, 2026 after the market close. A conference call will follow at 5:00 PM ET and will be webcast live from the investor relations portion of the Company's website at investor.texasroadhouse.com . Listeners may also access the call by dialing (833) 461-5787 and using conference ID 639749828. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company's Investor Relations website shortly after the conclusion of the call. About the Company Texas Roadhouse is a growing restaurant company operating predominantly in the casual dining segment that first opened in 1993 and today has grown to over 830 restaurants system-wide in 49 states, one U.S. territory, and ten foreign countries. For more information, please visit the Company’s Web site at www.texasroadhouse.com . Contacts: Investor Relations Michael

### Texas Roadhouse, Inc. to Announce Second Quarter Earnings on August 6, 2026


July 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/953769211/files/doc_news/Texas-Roadhouse-Inc--to-Announce-Second-Quarter-Earnings-on-August-6-2026-2026.pdf)


LOUISVILLE, Ky., July 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Texas Roadhouse, Inc. (NasdaqGS: TXRH) announced today that it will release second quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, August 6, 2026 after the market close. A conference call will follow at 5:00 PM ET and will be webcast live from the investor relations portion of the Company's website at[investor.texasroadhouse.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=WWrEZCyeZBerNcZI5PnHfGGqXrIjDq8gAZqlP-kWQmj_DY2K-PgZ3lNzvM7gmFHprJ17kPMX8w8GIjp4zInXf1SEyvRD0SCR87KjooalUaSQKfNeClYCPXk3acH3BA2L5Orr-jUTUZKtX-vBqrX3hQ==) .


Listeners may also access the call by dialing (833) 461-5787 and using conference ID 639749828. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company's Investor Relations website shortly after the conclusion of the call.


**About the Company**


Texas Roadhouse is a growing restaurant company operating predominantly in the casual dining segment that first opened in 1993 and today has grown to over 830 restaurants system-wide in 49 states, one U.S. territory, and ten foreign countries. For more information, please visit the Company’s Web site at[www.texasroadhouse.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_bu1xfImKMNgfeaBNjl658KeppAdXGhT7qxHfOH4BRoX3GzxLjjiHiUpvBOojOR92kD3n_Lg0Dg9UQgwXFaUer_qOLNjBF4WGUxh3JHk_hA=) .
